title: Card Transaction Dispute and Chargeback Procedure

planted.bug: Incomplete evidence loops back to the same review with nothing that changes the evidence and no cap or timeout for a customer who never responds
A suspected-fraud dispute of IDR 2,000,000 or less matches both C5.1 (provisional credit) and C5.3 (fraud unit)
A suspected-fraud dispute above IDR 2,000,000 matches both C5.2 (supervisor) and C5.3 (fraud unit)
Fraud investigation has no defined outcome (Annex C was removed), so the case dead-ends
10 + 5 working days (360h) > 14 calendar days (336h) on the chargeback path

notes: Intake (C3.2/C3.3: more than 120 vs within 120) and amount bands (C5.1/C5.2: 'or less' vs 'above') are deliberately gap-free: a finding there is a false positive.
